kaia-windrow.relationship: A mediator and the protector who carries every burden.
kaia-windrow.disagreement: Kaia waits for another way while Rook takes the failure onto himself.
kaia-windrow.circumstance: Rook carries the catastrophic failure so the others can act.
kaia-windrow.consequence: Passive balance has a cost; Kaia must intervene.
kaia-windrow.objective: Cross the contested center and commit to intervention before the window closes.
kaia-windrow.camera: Hold the empty protective space, then follow Kaia stepping into it.
kaia-windrow.aftermath: Waiting did not keep Rook safe. I will choose where to stand.
kaia-windrow.essence: Rook’s burden becomes a reminder to act.
kaia-windrow.gray: Wind binds six perspectives while Kaia deliberately enters the conflict.

ember-vale.relationship: Forceful conviction meets Nix’s need for restraint and listening.
ember-vale.disagreement: Ember presses forward while Nix asks her to hold space.
ember-vale.circumstance: Overwhelming force cannot preserve a fragile escape corridor.
ember-vale.consequence: Ember must listen without losing conviction.
ember-vale.objective: Hold the safe interval without attacking, then open room for Nix.
ember-vale.camera: Close on the stopped fist, then widen to the space Nix needed.
ember-vale.aftermath: I heard an obstacle when you were asking for room.
ember-vale.essence: Containment tempers combustion; borrowed perspective is restraint.
ember-vale.gray: Combustion carries other colors without consuming them.

rook-ironside.relationship: A protective guardian and a courier who needs agency.
rook-ironside.disagreement: Rook directs Juno to stay behind him; Juno chooses her own route.
rook-ironside.circumstance: Juno is lost from the immediate conflict while taking a route Rook cannot control.
rook-ironside.consequence: Protection must leave others room to choose.
rook-ironside.objective: Leave the exit open; defend alongside Juno instead of occupying her path.
rook-ironside.camera: Two parallel positions replace the single shield silhouette.
rook-ironside.aftermath: You chose. I should have stood beside you.
rook-ironside.essence: Juno’s speed loosens the urge to carry every choice.
rook-ironside.gray: Armor supports other perspectives rather than enclosing them.

juno-spark.relationship: Instinct and speed meet trajectories and deliberate planning.
juno-spark.disagreement: Juno mistakes hesitation for weakness; Orion discounts uncertainty and emotion.
juno-spark.circumstance: The Last Vector: Orion evaluates collapsing paths and emotionally chooses to hold the passage for Juno and the team.
juno-spark.consequence: Turning back would squander Orion’s sacrifice and endanger those still within reach.
juno-spark.objective: Choose to escort the remaining team, then traverse the stabilized passage. Turning back cannot complete the objective.
juno-spark.camera: Track Orion holding the vector, pause on Juno’s turn back, then follow the chosen forward line.
juno-spark.aftermath: You gave us a direction. I will use it for the people still here.
juno-spark.essence: Orion’s deliberate connection grounds acceleration; speed serves a chosen purpose.
juno-spark.gray: Juno pauses, chooses her vector, then accelerates; electricity remains her own.

nix-calder.relationship: A planner seeks certainty from someone whose trust cannot be contained.
nix-calder.disagreement: Nix equates confinement with safety; Vesper needs an honest opening.
nix-calder.circumstance: A perfectly bounded plan cannot guarantee that Vesper remains reachable.
nix-calder.consequence: Order must support freedom rather than imprison it.
nix-calder.objective: Open the containment boundary before traversing to the ally’s chosen position.
nix-calder.camera: A symmetrical frame breaks open toward an absent phase echo.
nix-calder.aftermath: The boundary was intact. The trust was not.
nix-calder.essence: Phase uncertainty becomes a permitted opening in structure.
nix-calder.gray: Construction supports spaces with deliberate exits.

orion-vell.relationship: A systems thinker and the mediator whose agency exceeds prediction.
orion-vell.disagreement: Orion predicts Kaia’s choices instead of asking what she needs.
orion-vell.circumstance: Kaia chooses an intervention outside Orion’s detached model.
orion-vell.consequence: Understanding requires a personal response, not prediction alone.
orion-vell.objective: Approach Kaia’s signal before using the marked vector; listen, then act.
orion-vell.camera: Leave the orbital overview for an eye-level shared frame.
orion-vell.aftermath: I knew the field. I did not ask what you needed.
orion-vell.essence: Wind makes orbital understanding responsive to a person.
orion-vell.gray: Six nodes retain independent paths while Orion responds to their needs.

vesper-nyx.relationship: Concealment meets Ember’s need for an honest declaration.
vesper-nyx.disagreement: Vesper withholds intent when Ember needs the truth to act.
vesper-nyx.circumstance: A concealed safe path fails to create connection when the escape depends on truth.
vesper-nyx.objective: Reveal the true escape signal, then follow its single visible path.
vesper-nyx.camera: Discard misleading phase echoes and hold one exposed face.
vesper-nyx.aftermath: I was afraid. I should have told you.
vesper-nyx.gray: Phase echoes carry perspectives while the chosen path remains truthful.
